$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0. STATUS: DESIGNED. The {grade, algebra} payload for grades on the TypeLL JSON-RPC wire (Panel-L <-> TypeLL, planned, not yet wired). Mirrors PanelClades.ABI.Grades.TaggedGrade, whose carriers are typed-wasm's grade kernel (src/abi/TypedWasm/ABI/ResourceAlgebra*, transcribed from hyperpolymath/resource-algebra) at the pin in panel-clades/scripts/fetch-siblings.sh. The algebra tag is required because the three grades are not interchangeable (resource-algebra Separation S-1..S-3): a loss of 2 is not a cost of 2 and not an occupancy of 2.
title: TypeLL graded value
description: A grade together with the kernel algebra it is drawn from.

algebra.description: loss = min-plus on N u {inf} (echo loss; Panel-N -> Panel-W crossing). maxplus = max-plus on N u {-inf} (worst-case cost). hwm = high-water mark (panel-state occupancy).

grade.description: The grade, in the encoding of its algebra.
Peak live state and drift (still held at the end). drift <= peak is an invariant of the kernel type that JSON Schema cannot express; a receiver must check it.
